name: Upset Temple Buyer
background: A dove or livestock seller ejected from the Temple courts. Resentful but not entirely without cause.

genericReactions.physical: What is this? It won't replace the doves I lost.
genericReactions.testimonial: I'll tell anyone who listens what happened. It was chaos.
genericReactions.digital: I don't care about records. I care about my livelihood.
genericReactions.environmental: The whole court is a mess. My stand was completely destroyed.
genericReactions.analytical: You can count coins, but can you count the cost of this 'cleansing'?
genericReactions.prophecy: Prophecy? I was just trying to make a living for the festival.
